result.instructions: Tools for GoTo Webinar, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which webinars do I have scheduled for the next two weeks?"; "How many people registered for the product launch webinar, and how many are approved?"; "Show the attendance and engagement figures for last week's customer webinar.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GoTo Webinar data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run goto_webinar_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run goto_webinar_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run goto_webinar_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. goto_webinar_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: goto_webinar_list_webinars
tools.title: List webinars
tools.description: List the organizer's webinars that start in a date range (default: now to 90 days ahead). Good first call to find a webinar key. GET /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars.

fromTime.description: Start of the range. Default: now.

toTime.description: End of the range. Default: 90 days after fromTime.

tools.name: goto_webinar_get_webinar
tools.title: Get webinar
tools.description: Get one webinar: subject, times, time zone, registration URL, registrant count and limit. GET /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars/{webinarKey}.

tools.name: goto_webinar_list_sessions
tools.title: List webinar sessions
tools.description: List the sessions of one webinar (a series or sequence has several). GET /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars/{webinarKey}/sessions.

tools.name: goto_webinar_get_performance
tools.title: Get webinar performance
tools.description: Get attendance and engagement figures for all sessions of one webinar. GET /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars/{webinarKey}/performance.

tools.name: goto_webinar_list_registrants
tools.title: List registrants
tools.description: List the registrants of one webinar with their status (WAITING, APPROVED or DENIED). Use goto_webinar_get_registrant for all fields. GET /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars/{webinarKey}/registrants.

tools.name: goto_webinar_get_registrant
tools.title: Get registrant
tools.description: Get one registrant with all captured fields and the join URL. GET /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars/{webinarKey}/registrants/{registrantKey}.

tools.name: goto_webinar_list_registration_fields
tools.title: List registration fields
tools.description: List the registration form fields of one webinar: required flag and allowed values, including custom fields. GET /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars/{webinarKey}/registrants/fields.

tools.name: goto_webinar_create_registrant
tools.title: Register a person for a webinar
tools.description: Register one person for a scheduled webinar. GoTo sends the person a confirmation email unless the organizer turned that off. Needs a GoTo Webinar plan that allows registration. POST /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars/{webinarKey}/registrants. Not retried.

source.description: Where the registration came from (optional tracking text).

resendConfirmation.description: Resend the confirmation email if the person already registered (default false).

annotations.title: Register a person for a webinar

tools.name: goto_webinar_list_attendees
tools.title: List attendees
tools.description: List the people who attended any session of one webinar. GET /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars/{webinarKey}/attendees.

tools.name: goto_webinar_list_panelists
tools.title: List panelists
tools.description: List the panelists (presenters) of one webinar. GET /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars/{webinarKey}/panelists.

tools.name: goto_webinar_list_recordings
tools.title: List recordings
tools.description: List the recording assets of one webinar. GET /webinars/{webinarKey}/recordingAssets.

tools.name: goto_webinar_create_webinar
tools.title: Schedule a webinar
tools.description: Schedule one single-session webinar for the organizer. Times are ISO 8601 UTC. Creates a visible webinar; it does not send registrant emails. POST /organizers/{organizerKey}/webinars. Not retried.

endTime.description: End, ISO 8601 UTC. Must be after startTime.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone shown to registrants, e.g. Europe/Prague.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with GoTo Webinar
prompts.description: What you can do with GoTo Webinar here, with example requests to try.
